proposal.observation: detected_lines.png: 12 vertical ring joints are found for 10 expected rings, but oblique yield is very low (about 10 positive-slope red and 6 negative-slope green segments over 12 joint columns, several of them tiny fragments), while blue horizontal fallback segments dominate. initial_prompt_points.png: only 10 prompt centres, of which 4 are 'midpoint', 2 are 'assume' (extrapolated) and just 4 come from real oblique intersections; spacing is irregular and clustered in the lower half. depth_map_viridis.png: broad NaN bands from the service tube and arched fittings (depth_nan_ratio 0.209) plus speckle holes. segmentation_results.png: 10 rings recovered (ring_count_error 0) and the K/B/A label sequence is present, but coverage is patchy (sam_fill_rate 0.73). correspondence_f1@15 = 0.453 is the weakest normalised measurement.
proposal.rule: d7 (m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered) -> f_missing_lines; precondition from r_relax_hough: rule out upstream f_joint_oversmoothed / f_depth_holes (d5/d6) first, so stage-3 densification and the stage-2 radial gate are adjusted jointly with the Hough relaxation. Inter-stage chain f_missing_lines -> unstable prompt centres -> f_crop_offset explains the low correspondence_f1@15.
proposal.failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (with likely upstream stage_3_upsample.f_joint_oversmoothed and mild stage_3_upsample.f_depth_holes)
proposal.rationale: Stage-1 is locked (residual 1.90 cm), so unfolding is untouched. The closest worked analogy is complex-correspondencef1at15-improve-s021 (same family, expected_rings=10, same dominant concern): a low curvature_threshold (~0.00037), permissive oblique Hough (threshold 27, maxLineGap 74), stricter horizontal fallback (60), pattern_tolerance 11, a tight radial gate (3.60/3.79) and SAM template 1874/1120/11.8 jointly raised correspondence_f1@15 0.446->0.460 and lowered depth_nan_ratio 0.208->0.197 at a small fill-rate cost, net proxy +0.008. The degrade analogies warn against the opposite moves: s028 (higher curvature_threshold 0.0013, oblique threshold 42, maxLineGap 35, mask_r_high 4.04) cut correspondence to 0.365, and g007 (mask_r_low 3.80 with mask_r_high 4.05) collapsed the lining to depth_nan_ratio 0.98, so mask_r_low is kept low (3.60) and mask_r_high is kept well below 4.0 but slightly looser than the analogy (3.85) to avoid over-gating a different T4 scan. Detecting values follow r_relax_hough: lower oblique threshold and higher maxLineGap_oblique to bridge the fragmented joint traces seen in the image, raise the horizontal threshold so horizontal fallback stops dominating the intersection set, and set pattern_tolerance 11 so the K/AB distance pattern accepts slightly more oblique intersections instead of falling back to 'assume' points. SAM values are set to the improving analogy's template (segment_width 1874, K_height 1120, angle 11.5) since the current 10-ring recovery should be preserved. This is a joint overlay; no per-parameter causal effect is claimed.
